content.reason: 현재 Specification package가 없고 이번 결정은 Project Core 필드가 아니라 active Agent Factory lifecycle skill의 내부 handoff 실행 계약을 변경한다. 요구사항과 검증 기준은 이 Intake와 Work Unit에 직접 보존한다.

content.objective: Implement and verify the lifecycle-owned two-checkpoint artifact handoff contract, deterministic Work Unit admission gate, and durable post-start execution continuation contract accepted in this Intake.
content.humanReviewMethod: Human은 변경 diff, checkpoint receipt, admission refusal evidence, interruption recovery와 idempotent replay test output, blocked recovery and explicit blocked outcome, exact changed-path 목록을 검토하고 Work Unit 승인·rework·integration을 별도로 결정한다.
scope: Add deterministic lifecycle-owned checkpoint and read-only inspection commands with a shared JSON receipt contract.
Validate ready Intake and ready Work Unit packages through their owning managers before Git mutation.
Enforce separate Human approval, exact path and message disclosure, exact staged file isolation, path and symlink safety, race detection, failure cleanup, and replay recovery.
Reconstruct the second checkpoint commit in a fresh session and use it as worktree.py prepare base without moving branch/worktree ownership out of work-unit-execution.

Implement one deterministic admission gate that rejects missing, ambiguous, invalid, incomplete, non-ready, blocker-bearing, execution-context-invalid, or Intake-basis-invalid Work Units before any execution side effect.
Mechanically couple admission to the earliest worktree mutation boundary so direct worktree.py invocation cannot bypass package readiness validation.
Persist durable step-level execution progress after attempt start and automatically resume the same attempt after process or session interruption without re-asking settled decisions.

Require idempotent retry behavior, bounded transient retry, explicit evidence-backed blocked outcomes, a blocker-resolution resume path, and regression coverage that prevents abandoned working attempts.
Update active lifecycle, intake, work-unit-planner, and work-unit-execution documentation.
Add focused unit and end-to-end temporary-repository tests and run the bundled plugin validator.
exclusions: Artifact JSON schema or profile redesign
Work Unit result integration or cleanup
Push, publication, marketplace mutation, reinstall, or PR promotion
expectedOutputs: skills/lifecycle/SKILL.md and skills/lifecycle/references/lifecycle.md handoff, admission, and durable continuation contract updates

skills/work-unit-planner/assets/scripts/work_unit.py, skills/work-unit-planner/SKILL.md, references/work-unit-structure.md, and manager tests for mechanically enforced admission, versioned durable progress, and blocked recovery

skills/work-unit-execution/scripts/worktree.py, skills/work-unit-execution/SKILL.md, references/worktree-contract.md, and tests for package-aware pre-mutation refusal, inspected checkpoint base, resume, and blocked evidence
plan: Write failing tests for both checkpoint phases, admission refusal paths, exact staging, replay, inspection, and validation-to-stage swap.

Write a failing test proving worktree preparation refuses missing, invalid, incomplete, non-ready, blocker-bearing, execution-context-invalid, and Intake-basis-invalid packages before branch or path creation.
Write interruption and recovery tests that simulate a stopped Codex invocation, reconstruct canonical step progress, and resume the same revision and attempt.
Write a regression test for active-attempt blocked transition, blocker resolution, and deterministic resume without lifecycle deadlock.
Implement lifecycle commands with argument-array Git execution and deterministic receipts.
Implement mechanically coupled admission before worktree preparation or execution-state mutation.

Implement versioned durable progress checkpoints, idempotent retry identity, bounded transient retry, recovery ownership, and evidence-backed blocked outcomes without adding an unapproved lifecycle status.
Update lifecycle boundary documentation and manager handoff instructions.
Run focused tests, relevant regression tests, plugin validation, AI review, and Human-facing report preparation.

Change artifact_handoff checkpoint and inspection verification to distinguish changed commit paths from the complete canonical package tree and validated hashes.
Preserve exact canonical staging isolation, unrelated staged refusal, symlink and race defenses, replay recovery, approval boundaries, and receipt behavior.
